title: Automated Tissue Fixation with 10% NBF (Leica)
author: Donna Skinner
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.67uhhnw

steps.title: Select processing program
steps.instruction: Based on the size, thickness, and type of the tissue sample, decide whether to run the Formalin Short Program or the Formalin Long Program on the Leica ASP300 S Fully Enclosed Tissue Processor.

steps.title: Load tissue cassettes
steps.instruction: Place the tissue cassettes containing the specimens into the loading tray of the Leica ASP300 S, making sure each cassette is properly seated and secured.

steps.title: Configure short program
steps.instruction: Program the Leica ASP300 S with the Formalin Short Program sequence, setting each station exactly as listed:

substeps.instruction: Station 2 – 10% NBF: 12 seconds at 40 °C, vacuum on (Y).
Station 3 – 70% Ethyl Alcohol: 15 seconds at 40 °C, vacuum on (Y).
Station 4 – 95% Ethyl Alcohol: 15 seconds at 40 °C, vacuum on (Y).
Station 5 – 95% Ethyl Alcohol: 20 seconds at 40 °C, vacuum on (Y).
Station 6 – 100% Ethyl Alcohol: 20 seconds at 40 °C, vacuum on (Y).
Station 7 – 100% Ethyl Alcohol: 20 seconds at 40 °C, vacuum on (Y).
Station 8 – Xylene: 20 seconds at 40 °C, vacuum on (Y).
Station 9 – Xylene: 30 seconds at 40 °C, vacuum on (Y).
Station 10 – Paraffin Wax 1: 5 seconds at 60 °C, vacuum on (Y).
Station 11 – Paraffin Wax 2: 10 seconds at 60 °C, vacuum on (Y).
Station 12 – Paraffin Wax 3: 15 seconds at 60 °C, vacuum on (Y).

steps.title: Configure long program
steps.instruction: Program the Leica ASP300 S with the Formalin Long Program sequence, setting each station exactly as listed:

substeps.instruction: Station 2 – 10% NBF: 2 hours at 40 °C, vacuum on (Y).
Station 3 – 70% Ethyl Alcohol: 45 seconds at 40 °C, vacuum on (Y).
Station 4 – 95% Ethyl Alcohol: 45 seconds at 40 °C, vacuum on (Y).
Station 5 – 95% Ethyl Alcohol: 45 seconds at 40 °C, vacuum on (Y).
Station 6 – 100% Ethyl Alcohol: 30 seconds at 40 °C, vacuum on (Y).
Station 7 – 100% Ethyl Alcohol: 1 minute at 40 °C, vacuum on (Y).
Station 8 – 100% Ethyl Alcohol: 30 minutes at 40 °C, vacuum on (Y).
Station 9 – Xylene: 30 minutes at 40 °C, vacuum on (Y).
Station 10 – Xylene: 30 minutes at 40 °C, vacuum on (Y).
Station 11 – Paraffin Wax 1: 30 minutes at 60 °C, vacuum on (Y).
Station 12 – Paraffin Wax 2: 30 minutes at 60 °C, vacuum on (Y).
Station 13 – Paraffin Wax 3: 30 minutes at 60 °C, vacuum on (Y).

steps.title: Start processing
steps.instruction: Initiate the selected program (short or long). The Leica ASP300 S will automatically progress through the programmed stations, applying vacuum where indicated and maintaining the specified temperatures and times for each reagent.
